newsitem.title: EGYPT: Israeli negotiator says gap with Palestinians.
newsitem.headline: Israeli negotiator says gap with Palestinians.

text.p: An Israeli negotiator said on Wednesday his country and the Palestinians had to bridge a big gap before they could resume peace talks.

Israeli cabinet secretary Danny Naveh made the remarks to reporters after he and two other negotiators met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak's senior adviser Osama el-Baz in Cairo in a bid to jump-start stalled talks between the Jewish state and the Palestinians.

"We appreciate Egypt's role, especially Dr. Osama el-Baz's shuttle missions to Gaza and Israel to bring the two sides closer. There is still a big gap and we will continue to work to close the gap," Neveh said before returning to Israel.
He gave no details of what his team discussed with Baz in almost three hours of talks.
Substantive talks between Israel and the Palestinians collapsed in March after the Jewish state began building a new settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
Baz has been mediating between the two sides for the past few weeks.
